families.rationale: Initial settings vary inputs per split, node size, sampling and split rule; later proposals spread these controls. Screening uses 128 trees before complete CV with 128 trees; final refits use 500 trees. Every requested CV fold and every fold-training row is retained. CV scores describe 128-tree fits and do not measure the final 500-tree model exactly. The held-out evaluation measures the final model; it does not select this budget.
